//: Pins the SDK floor so a checkout builds the same way everywhere.
10.0.100 is the minimum that can build the net10.0 target at all. rollForward
latestMajor keeps newer SDKs working without a repo edit, which matters because
the GitHub-hosted runner images move on their own schedule; the language version
is pinned separately in Directory.Build.props, so a newer SDK does not quietly
Contributors on an older SDK can still build every target except net10.0 by
passing -f, but `dotnet build` on the solution will tell them to upgrade rather
than failing later with a confusing NETSDK1045.
